column1: # swarm manifest — single source of truth for what an `engineering-cto`
# swarm contains. Consumed by swarm-init.sh, swarm-sync.sh, and
# swarm-onboard.sh via manifest_walk in swarm-lib.sh, so first-stamp,
# upgrade, and onboard cannot diverge. Add a new artifact in ONE place: here.
# Per-type dispatch: at apply time, swarm_type_of() resolves a repo's
# archetype from its .claude/swarm-type marker (default 'engineering-cto')
# and the manifest at templates/<type>/manifest.tsv is consumed.
# Format: behavior | template-path | target-path
#   - lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored
#   - fields are pipe-delimited, leading/trailing whitespace per field is trimmed
#   - template-path is relative to $SWARM_HOME/templates/
#     (except seed-text, where this field is the literal text to seed)
#   - target-path is relative to the target repo
#     (except gitignore, where this field is .gitignore itself; the
#     template-path is the line we ensure is present in it)
# Behavior classes (each implemented as manifest_apply_<class> in swarm-lib.sh):
#   refresh     overwrite unconditionally (idempotent if cmp-equal); doctrine
#               and enforcement files that encode the operating contract
#   compose     concatenate '+'-joined sources LITERALLY (no separator
#               injected) into a tmp file, then refresh semantics against
#               the target. Each non-final source MUST end with at least
#               one '\n' so the seam is well-formed (see _base/README.md
#               for the trailing-newline invariant).
#   seed        copy only if absent in target; per-repo content the operator
#               (or CTO) authors after stamping. --force in init re-seeds.
#   seed-text   write literal text from template-path field into target, only
#               if absent. Same semantics as seed but for tiny inline content.
#   operator-owned
#               like seed (write-if-absent on init/onboard, never on sync)
#               but with one CRITICAL difference: --force does NOT re-seed.
#               For content the OPERATOR authors and owns (e.g. cpo
#               product-vision.md). swarm-init --force never clobbers it;
#               sync never touches it; the auto-stamped .claude/operator-
#               owned-paths list is read by the pre-commit hook (Layer 3)
#               to refuse teammate-worktree commits of any listed path. To
#               reset operator-owned content, the operator deletes the
#               file by hand and re-runs init.
#   settings    structured-merge swarm hook registrations + env + permissions
#               into the existing settings.json. Never clobber; additive +
#               dedup-by-command. See manifest_apply_settings.
#   git-hook    marker-aware: install if absent or existing has SWARM-MANAGED
#               marker; otherwise refuse (warn in init/sync, refuse with
#               COLLISION in onboard unless --force-precommit).
#   gitignore   append the line in template-path to .gitignore idempotently.
# behavior   | template-path                                                                                            | target-path
compose      | engineering-cto/CLAUDE.preamble.md+_base/CLAUDE.md+engineering-cto/CLAUDE.md                              | CLAUDE.md
compose      | engineering-cto/ESCALATION.preamble.md+_base/ESCALATION.md+engineering-cto/ESCALATION.md                  | ESCALATION.md
refresh      | engineering-cto/TEAM_LEAD.md                                                                              | TEAM_LEAD.md
seed         | engineering-cto/PROJECT_SPEC.template.md                                                                  | PROJECT_SPEC.md
seed         | engineering-cto/ADR.template.md                                                                           | docs/adr/ADR.template.md
refresh      | engineering-cto/hooks/test-gate.sh                                                                        | .claude/hooks/test-gate.sh
refresh      | engineering-cto/hooks/docs-check.sh                                                                       | .claude/hooks/docs-check.sh
refresh      | engineering-cto/hooks/permission-gate.sh                                                                  | .claude/hooks/permission-gate.sh
refresh      | engineering-cto/hooks/dod-affirm.sh                                                                       | .claude/hooks/dod-affirm.sh
settings     | engineering-cto/settings.example.json                                                                     | .claude/settings.json
git-hook     | engineering-cto/git-hooks/pre-commit                                                                      | .git/hooks/pre-commit
gitignore    | .claude/worktrees/                                                                                        | .gitignore
seed-text    | npm test --silent                                                                                         | .claude/test-cmd
